title: Pin every fix with a test
statement: Pin every rule added after a judging failure with a deterministic test that breaks if its text is removed or moved, and with a labelled case that exercises it.
detail: Each reported disagreement from issue 371 to issue 1004 got a test that checks its guidance string sits in the right prompt file, so an edit that removes or moves it is caught without a model call (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/tests/test_evaluator_prompt_rules_371_382.py`), and several also got a labelled regression case (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/tests/test_evaluator_prompt_rules_1004.py`). The labelled set then runs as a pass-rate gate in continuous integration (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/.github/workflows/quality-gates.yml`).
against: A string test catches a deleted rule, not whether the rule works, and the pass threshold differs by place: 0.95 in the labelled set's own file, 0.98 as the runner's default and 0.99 in continuous integration (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/golden/golden_dataset.json`, line 4; `icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/golden/runner.py`, line 285).

evidence.quote: The tests check that the relevant guidance string is present in the right prompt file so that edits removing or relocating it are caught deterministically (no LLM).
mandatory regression tests for observed failures
